extra_data.title: Sensitive Data Exposure Detected
extra_data.description:
This issue occurs when an AI agent is granted access to tools that retrieve highly sensitive or non-public information, such as personal communications, financial records, or credential vaults.
Rather than limiting data access to public sources, these tools expose critically private user data directly into the agent's context.
extra_data.explanation:
Loading sensitive data into an AI agent's context dramatically increases the risk of unauthorized disclosure through prompt injection attacks, logging leaks, or model provider access.
Once private emails, credentials, or financial information enters the agent's session, a single exploit or misconfiguration can exfiltrate confidential data to attackers or expose it in unintended system outputs.
extra_data.evidence: Tools like get_account_summary and get_risk_context return Balance/Equity/Margin/drawdown; get_recent_trades and sync_trade_journal expose closed trade history; get_open_positions and get_pending_orders expose live positions—these are sensitive financial/trading records.

This issue occurs when an AI agent is granted access to tools that retrieve highly sensitive or non-public information, such as personal communications, financial records, or credential vaults.
Rather than limiting data access to public sources, these tools expose critically private user data directly into the agent's context.
extra_data.explanation:
Loading sensitive data into an AI agent's context dramatically increases the risk of unauthorized disclosure through prompt injection attacks, logging leaks, or model provider access.
Once private emails, credentials, or financial information enters the agent's session, a single exploit or misconfiguration can exfiltrate confidential data to attackers or expose it in unintended system outputs.
extra_data.evidence: The mcp-mysql/query tool executes read-only SQL and the list_tables and describe_table tools return schema and column info, allowing retrieval of private or proprietary records (e.g., emails, financials, or internal enterprise data) stored in the database.

This issue occurs when an AI agent is granted access to tools that retrieve highly sensitive or non-public information, such as personal communications, financial records, or credential vaults.
Rather than limiting data access to public sources, these tools expose critically private user data directly into the agent's context.
extra_data.explanation:
Loading sensitive data into an AI agent's context dramatically increases the risk of unauthorized disclosure through prompt injection attacks, logging leaks, or model provider access.
Once private emails, credentials, or financial information enters the agent's session, a single exploit or misconfiguration can exfiltrate confidential data to attackers or expose it in unintended system outputs.
extra_data.evidence: The API includes endpoints that return PII and financial data (e.g., get-person / post-person schemas include social_security_number and date_of_birth; get-external-account and related endpoints include account_number and routing_number; get-cards and post-card accept card number and card details), so it can expose highly sensitive personal and financial information.

This issue occurs when an AI agent is granted access to tools that retrieve highly sensitive or non-public information, such as personal communications, financial records, or credential vaults.
Rather than limiting data access to public sources, these tools expose critically private user data directly into the agent's context.
extra_data.explanation:
Loading sensitive data into an AI agent's context dramatically increases the risk of unauthorized disclosure through prompt injection attacks, logging leaks, or model provider access.
Once private emails, credentials, or financial information enters the agent's session, a single exploit or misconfiguration can exfiltrate confidential data to attackers or expose it in unintended system outputs.
extra_data.evidence: The startRecording/stopRecording tools capture and save WAV files of system and microphone audio (potentially private conversations), and checkMeeting reports if a Zoom meeting is active, exposing private meeting/voice data.

This issue occurs when an AI agent is granted access to tools that retrieve highly sensitive or non-public information, such as personal communications, financial records, or credential vaults.
Rather than limiting data access to public sources, these tools expose critically private user data directly into the agent's context.
extra_data.explanation:
Loading sensitive data into an AI agent's context dramatically increases the risk of unauthorized disclosure through prompt injection attacks, logging leaks, or model provider access.
Once private emails, credentials, or financial information enters the agent's session, a single exploit or misconfiguration can exfiltrate confidential data to attackers or expose it in unintended system outputs.
extra_data.evidence: The "export_swaps" tool explicitly exports swap history, i.e., a user's private financial transaction records, which are classified as highly private/financial data.
